decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly generating mana through rituals and medallions to cast Ral, Monsoon Mage and other spells that allow for card draw. The goal is to set up a combo with Past in Flames to cast multiple spells in a turn, usually leading to a win condition. The deck also utilizes cards like Artist's Talent and Wish to search for specific pieces of the combo. Overall, the strategy involves ramping up mana production efficiently to pull off a lethal sequence of spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures with aggressive abilities like haste and trample to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes spells and enchantments to control the battlefield and deal direct damage to the opponent, allowing for a fast and aggressive playstyle. Additionally, there are cards that provide support and protection for the creatures, ensuring their effectiveness in combat. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to maintain a relentless offensive strategy while also having some control over the opponent's board state.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early in the game, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to apply pressure. Cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge provide additional reach to close out the game. Additionally, the inclusion of Blood Moon and Static Prison helps disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah offer versatility and resilience in combat.

The focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of disruptive spells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Counterspell, while also efficiently removing threats with Fatal Push. The deck utilizes graveyard interaction with cards like Cling to Dust and Unearth, as well as card draw and filtering with cards like Consider and Thought Scour. The win condition comes from powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus, backed up by counters and removal to protect them.

The deck focuses on the Amulet Titan combo, using Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and lands like Urza's Saga to generate powerful and explosive plays. It aims to ramp quickly with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Azusa, Lost but Seeking, while also utilizing land tutors like Tolaria West and Expedition Map to find key pieces like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. With the ability to generate significant mana and multiple land drops per turn, the deck can set up deadly combos and overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and direct damage threats.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly develop a board presence with low-cost creatures and planeswalkers, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison. The deck focuses on dealing consistent damage through creature attacks and burn spells, while utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment for additional reach. With an aggressive game plan and a mix of disruption and card advantage, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to continuously recur cards from the graveyard, generating infinite mana and drawing the entire deck. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station play essential roles in triggering the combo, while Mox Opal and Mox Amber help ramp up mana quickly. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student can also be used to dig for combo pieces. Thassa's Oracle serves as the win condition, allowing the player to deck themselves and win the game upon resolving its ETB ability. This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win in a single turn.

This deck revolves around using Underworld Breach in combination with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to repeatedly mill through your deck and generate mana, allowing you to cast spells from your graveyard. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps you find the pieces you need, while Mishra's Bauble and Mishra's Research Desk provide additional card draw. Malevolent Rumble and Unholy Heat serve as removal and disruption against your opponent's threats. By quickly assembling your combo pieces, you can win the game by casting Grapeshot or by generating infinite mana with Mox Amber and Breeding Pool.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It combines traditional combo elements with a creative twist, utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Persist to generate value and accelerate the combo. The deck also includes disruption through cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the board and protect the combo. Overall, the deck aims to surprise opponents with its unique approach to combo strategies in the Modern format.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive elements like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the board. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells, while also having the versatility to adapt to different game situations. The key strategy is to maintain a fast pace and apply consistent pressure to secure victory before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck aims to aggressively cast spells with Cascade to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea to cascade into high-impact cards like Scion of Draco and Crashing Footfalls, the deck can create a fast and efficient board presence. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support to protect and enhance the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck focuses on casting multiple spells per turn to gain a tempo advantage and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces needed to win the game quickly. It utilizes cards like Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Urza's Saga to generate advantage and combo off. The deck has a mix of control elements like Unholy Heat and disruption like Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and help with finding key pieces. The goal is to set up a powerful board state and win through a combo finish.

This deck focuses on quickly milling the opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap while controlling the board with cards like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch. The goal is to fill up the opponent's graveyard as fast as possible and then use cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter and Fractured Sanity to mill out the remaining cards. The deck also includes some graveyard hate with Surgical Extraction and Crypt Incursion to disrupt the opponent's strategy and stay ahead in the mill game.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Underworld Breach combo to continuously recur artifacts from the graveyard, allowing for explosive plays and combos with cards like Grinding Station, Urza's Saga, and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to generate value by sacrificing and recurring artifacts, creating a loop that can overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage, mana generation, and direct damage. The inclusion of cards like Skittering Precursor and Glaring Fleshraker also provide additional threats and disruption to control the game.

The main concept of this deck is to apply pressure early in the game through aggressive creatures such as Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Dragon's Rage Channeler while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board and finish off opponents. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection with spells like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to maintain consistency and find the necessary pieces to close out the game quickly. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Underworld Breach provide additional utility and value to out-grind opponents in longer games.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Guide of Souls, paired with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It also includes cards like Static Prison and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to control the board and protect your creatures. The mana base includes fetch lands like Arid Mesa and Marsh Flats to ensure consistency in casting your spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats.
